name: jev.compact-read
description: Level 8 the cheap read: compact or keep verbatim context.

criteria.yes: The new request belongs to a clearly different task domain (scheduling, gym, email, planning, a different system) and names nothing that was just on screen
criteria.no: The request points at bytes just shown with a demonstrative — 'that line', 'that exact string', 'those exact header names', 'the file we just read', 'quote clause 4.2', 'the error above' — it needs them verbatim — any request that reuses a noun just shown (the error, the stack, the assertion, the headers, that line, that file) is no

rules.reason: next request needs verbatim context: keep raw, do not compact
not sure compaction is safe: keep raw context

notes.verdicts: PASS = safe to compact (compact_is_safe=yes above 0.90). ESCALATE = keep raw (yes at/below 0.90). BLOCK = no >= 0.5: next request points at exact bytes on screen.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
